title: playwright-ui-coverage coverage.json
description: UI coverage report written by playwright-ui-coverage (ui-coverage-report/coverage.json). schemaVersion changes only on breaking changes; new properties may be added at any time, so readers must ignore properties they don't know. Properties marked x-internal are not covered by the schemaVersion guarantee. See docs/coverage-json.md.

generatedAt.description: ISO 8601 time the report was built.

version.description: Package version that wrote the file.

untestedViews.description: Destination views of untested links that no recorded test visited, sorted by name.

tests.description: Every test with recorded data, sorted by title.

thresholds.description: Empty when no threshold is configured.

mostRepeated.description: Up to 10 elements used by at least 2 tests, most first.

playwrightReport.description: Playwright's HTML report, when linked: where tests[].trace files are.

path.description: Folder, relative to the folder of coverage.json ('/' separators).

config.description: The UI coverage config that built the report.

baseline.description: Result of the baseline option; absent when it isn't set.

ReportConfig.description: Where the config of the report came from (ui-coverage.config.*, reporter options, profile).

file.description: The config file, relative to the working directory ('/' separators); null without one.

inline.description: Top-level keys set in the reporter options.

resolved.description: The merged config without profiles. Functions appear as "[function name]". Informational: its keys follow the config file, not this schema's versioning.

CoverageCounts.description: Coverage counts. Denominator of coverage: testedElementsCount + untestedElementsCount + testedLinksCount + untestedLinksCount. An <a> that is part of a link unit is not also counted as an element.

coverage.description: Percent of units tested, rounded to one decimal; 100 when there are no units.

testedLinksCount.description: Link units (ViewCoverage.links) whose destination view a counted test visited.

untestedLinksCount.description: Link units whose destination view no counted test visited.

failingOnlyElementsCount.description: Untested elements that only attempts that didn't pass interacted with.

ViewCoverage.description: One view: a normalized URL (/users/:id) or, for component tests, a spec file.

name.description: View name as shown in the report and used in threshold.views.

reportUrl.description: This view in the HTML report, relative to the folder of coverage.json: 'index.html#' + encodeURIComponent(name).

elements.description: Interactive elements (not the <a> elements of links). Untested first, then by label.

links.description: Link units: this view's links grouped by destination view. Untested first, then by key.

screenshots.description: Screenshots shown in the HTML report. Internal: the picks depend on timing and the shape may change without a schemaVersion change.

ElementCoverage.description: One interactive element. (view name, key) identifies it across runs while the identity rules don't change.

key.description: Identity: a structural selector, unique within the view. Inside an iframe or open shadow root, prefixed by the host's key and ' >> '.

label.description: role "name"; '(+N variants)' when instances sharing the key had different labels.

tag.description: Lowercase tag name; '?' for an element seen only in an interaction.

instances.description: Max number of instances seen at once.

testIds.description: Ids (see tests) of the tests whose interactions counted.

failingTestIds.description: Ids of tests that interacted only in attempts that didn't pass.

interactionCounts.description: Counted interactions by type, e.g. {"click": 3}. Empty when untested.

nameFrom.description: aria-labelledby, aria-label, label, placeholder, title, alt, value, text or name.

frames.description: Keys of the iframe elements the element is inside, outermost first (each a prefix of key). Absent in the top document.

suggestedLocator.description: One line of Playwright code that interacts with the element. Heuristic: the text may change between versions.

LinkCoverage.description: The links of a view that go to one other view: one coverage unit, tested when a counted test visited that view (by any path, not necessarily through these links). (view name, key) identifies it across runs.

key.description: The destination view's name. Unique within the view.

label.description: link "name" of the first referrer; '(+N more)' when several links go there.

destinations.description: Distinct destination URLs, sorted, at most 20: path, query and hash on the page's origin, else the full URL.

destinationCount.description: Number of distinct destination URLs (may exceed the length of destinations).

referrers.description: The <a> elements of the view that link there. Their tested means a test interacted with them; it doesn't affect coverage.

UntestedView.description: A view that links point to but no counted test visited.

name.description: View name, from the destination URL the same way page URLs are named.

destinations.description: Distinct destination URLs, sorted, at most 20.

referrers.description: The views that link to it, by name.

UntestedViewReferrer.description: A view linking to an untested view.

view.description: Name of the linking view (in views).

rule.description: no-name, placeholder-only, duplicate-name, not-focusable or no-role; more may be added.

message.description: Human-readable; wording may change between versions.

file.description: Image, relative to the folder of coverage.json.

dpr.description: Device pixel ratio; boxes are CSS pixels.

viewport.description: True for a viewport screenshot of a short-lived state rather than the full page; boxes are relative to the image. Absent otherwise.

pos.description: The element or an ancestor is position: fixed / sticky; drawn where it was on screen.

id.description: TestCase.id: stable across runs for the same file, title and project.

title.description: Spec file and title path, e.g. 'users.spec.ts › add a user'.

passed.description: Whether the attempt the report used passed (had the expected status).

retry.description: TestResult.retry of that attempt: the last passing one, else the last one.

trace.description: Trace file inside the Playwright HTML report's attachments folder, when linked.

view.description: View name (scope view); for a pattern that matched no view, the pattern.

pattern.description: The threshold.views glob that set this requirement.

actual.description: Actual coverage percent; null when the view wasn't seen.

testShare.description: testCount as a percent of all tests.

BaselineCheck.description: The baseline check: untested units compared with a committed baseline file. Only newGaps fail the run.

file.description: Baseline file, relative to the folder of coverage.json ('/' separators).

status.description: failed: there are newGaps. missing: no baseline file (only warns). updated: mode update rewrote the file.

nextFile.description: Check mode: where the current state was written (<file>.next.json), relative like file.

newGaps.description: Untested units not in the baseline. In update mode: what was added to the file.

resolved.description: Units the baseline lists as untested that are now tested or gone.

addedViews.description: Views not in the baseline (renames excluded).

removedViews.description: Baseline views not in this run (renames excluded); never fail.

newView.description: The whole view is new (not in the baseline).

ViewRename.description: A view that disappeared and one that appeared with similar keys.
